text: Where, freed from the fear of Jitasimha, the Nagas dwell, and the horses are the bilayonas; where the Yakshas, the Kimpurushas, the Pauras, the women, and the forest deities reside. Where the clouds, clinging to the peaks, manifest as the dwellings of the gods, their thunderous voices resonating in doubt and harmony. Where, with the swaying branches of the Kalpavriksha trees, the glory of the banners is seized, crafted by the non-Pauras in their reverence.
